text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And coming in first, it's...
Matikanetannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?! I won?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: No way! Matikanetannhauser won?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon was impressive out
there too, but you never really know
what'll happen once
those gates burst
open!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: D-d-did I really do it?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Defeat...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A collective groan runs through all the
fans who
had pinned their hopes on
Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Woo! I guess that's step one on the way
to
becoming Triple Crown champion
done and
dusted!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I need to keep this momentum up for the

Japanese Der—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hey, is Bourbon... okay?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Failure to secure victory in the Satsuki
Sho has rendered the Triple Crown
unattainable. The one
and only dream
that I shared with Father is...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Oxygen levels declining below normal
levels.
Cause unknown. Executing
emergency deep
breathing.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Inhale... Exhale... Inhale... Exhale...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. The next race is the Japanese
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Even if I'm defeated, I cannot stop
running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon quickly leaves the
racecourse.
Behind her, a small figure
runs up, as if to chase
after her.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...No, this isn't the time to worry.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't anywhere near good enough
today! At
this rate... I'll never reach her.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
At this rate... I'll never make anyone
smile!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I need to get stronger... Much, much
stronger!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...That's right. It's normal to be happy
when you
win and frustrated when you
lose.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
But did you see how quickly they both
started
thinking of the next race?! What
drive!

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me! Congratulations on your

magnificent victory!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hyah! I m-mean, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Reporter
text_block_list.text:
If it's not too much trouble,
could I get a 
statement about your enthusiasm for the

Japanese Derby?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Enthusiasm! Right, um... enthuuusiasm...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm, uh, gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huuuh. Let me just jot that down.
"...gonna...
win..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Reporter
text_block_list.text: ...Umm, is that all?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yep!

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Reporter
text_block_list.text: Oh! Okay, I see! Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehe! I'm gonna do my best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The mood is a bit flat... but if she says
she'll do
her best, I know that's what
she'll do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the Japanese Derby. Let's go
get
another win!
